evidence: Carries the Consensus label and modifies signature-cache key construction in src/script/sigcache.{cpp,h}.
rationale: Eliminating un-delimited byte stream hashing hardens the signature cache against future script extensions, but addresses no active vulnerability. As the description notes, the encoding is already 'unambiguous for inputs accepted by its current script checker', making this proactive defense-in-depth refactoring that is reasonably deferrable.
